errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор, обозначен „От 16 до 30 години“, е зелен и представлява около 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The green slice for „От 16 до 30 години“ is labeled about 13.6%, but the text implies this is the same size as another 13.6% slice; in the chart, the green slice is 13.6%, while the other visible small slices are much smaller (around 4.5% each), so the description is misleading about the distribution of the remaining sectors.

errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор, обозначен „От 16 до 30 години“, е зелен и представлява около 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The chart shows only one green sector at about 13.6%; the description assigns 13.6% to the green sector correctly but fails to account for the other two small sectors, each around 4.5%, making the numeric breakdown incomplete and misleading in context.
The description states the question but does not clearly identify that the figure is summarizing 22 responses, which is visible in the chart and helps define the chart's purpose.

errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по посока на часовниковата стрелка, като се започва от най-големия сектор и продължава по намаляващ ред на размера.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in a strictly descending order around the pie. After the two largest 36.4% slices and the 13.6% green slice, the remaining small slices are not shown in a simple monotonic descending sequence.
